action.new_text:
"""Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
    # Validate inputs
    for arr, name in [(logp_with_result, 'logp_with_result'),
                      (logp_call_only, 'logp_call_only'),
                      (logp_no_call, 'logp_no_call')]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy array")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D matrix")
        if arr.size == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if np.any(np.isnan(arr)) or np.any(np.isinf(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains nonfinite values")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values")
    # Check shape consistency
    shape = logp_with_result.shape
    if logp_call_only.shape != shape or logp_no_call.shape != shape:
        raise ValueError("All three input matrices must have the same shape")
    # Validate tau_filter (no booleans)
    if isinstance(tau_filter, (bool, np.bool_)):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative")

    # Compute normalized decreasing future-token weights (T01)
    future_horizon = shape[1]
    t = np.arange(future_horizon)  # offsets from call token
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)  # shape (future_horizon,)
    weight_sum = raw_weights.sum()
    if weight_sum <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Future horizon too short to produce positive weights")
    normalized_weights = raw_weights / weight_sum  # broadcast over candidates

    # Weighted sums over the future tokens for each candidate
    w_with = np.sum(logp_with_result * normalized_weights, axis=1)
    w_call = np.sum(logp_call_only * normalized_weights, axis=1)
    w_no = np.sum(logp_no_call * normalized_weights, axis=1)

    # Margin: (with_result) - max(call_only, no_call)
    margin = w_with - np.maximum(w_call, w_no)

    # Keep if margin strictly greater than threshold
    keep = margin > tau_filter

    return keep, margin
